raw_sections.experience:
Experience
TCS BPS Ops Manager :
Nov 2021 - Sep 2025
Managed KYC QA Project for APAC region (14 countries) for a leading Investment Bank :
Handled day-to-day operations for the project with a team of 29 FTEs, by adhering to SLA/KPI. Involved in client coordination, escalation management, internal/external audits and Stakeholders
meeting.
Led process improvement initiatives and conducted daily team huddles to address team issues. Managed recruitment and training, BGC, team performance, management, Quality Dashboards
publication, QA SOP handling, Compliance Meeting, Billing and Invoice generation.
Program Manager : (PMO Role)
Managed 4 KYC Projects with 86 resources for a reputed investment bank, responsible for Project handling, Capacity Planning, Budget discussion, SLA/KPI Metrics, Internal Audit, Project Governance, Stakeholders Management, Client Coordination, Contractual agreement process, Saled Coordination, Escalation handling, Performance management and Improvement, Risk Assessment, CSAT Survey, RCA reports, Resource Hiring and Training, BGC, Setting Goals, Stakeholders Meeting, Dashboards Preparation, Billing/invoice Generation, PMO activities and MIS Reporting.
:
Achieved
across all managed projects by prioritising clear communication
Successfully, timely delivery and stakeholders' expectations.
Improved FTR from 78% to 96% for one of highly expected projects within 3 months of project initiation by
team huddles, training, error discussion, documentation and SME support.
JP Morgan Chase Team Leader :
Apr 2017 - Nov 2021
Supervised KYC remediation/renewal processes and Team performance across WHEM, EMEA, and APAC regions:
Worked for various Client types like, Corporate, NBFI, Publicly Traded, NOAH, Banks and
Connected Funds.
Worked for Low, Medium and High risk entities. Preparations of reports like MIS, Quality and Productivity report...etc.
Focused on regulatory compliance requirements in KYC :
Led the BREXIT quality check project, training teams on new compliance processes Supervised audits and reporting for UK Grid compliance requirements
Wipro BPS Senior Analyst (Stream Lead) :
Aug 2014 - Apr 2017
Worked for KYC Remediation project (EMEA and APAC regions) for a leading Investment Bank, through CDD/MDD/EDD modules.
Team Handling and supervision as back up to TM. As a stream lead, deciding on plan of action for the day, work allocation, quality check, performance
feedback and lead the stream and report to management.
Train and educate the team on process updates and handle the escalations, if any. As a Case Lead role responsible for end-to-end completion of the record by doing Gap Analysis,
screening, obtaining docs from KYC Owner.
Preparations of reports like MIS, Quality and Productivity report...etc.
:
Moved to Case Lead role based the performance in the Utility. ● Represented Wipro as the SME (out of 3) to procure one of the KYC projects from prospective clients. ● Got selected as a Quality Spoc to represent Wipro for discussion with Client. ● Identified as a Process Trainer to train new joinees on KYC process front.
Deutsche Bank Process Supervisor (TL grade) :
May 2007 - May 2013
KYC Onboarding and Cash Ops : Worked for KYC Operations and Cash Ops (Trade Account Opening/Maintenance, Signatories update, Account Closure..etc) process for APAC and EMEA regions.
Team Handling and supervision.
Quality Assurance
Internal Audits
Volume Management
SOP renewal
Meetings with Onshore Counterparts
Preparing MIS report, Cap module, KPI...etc.
Transactions Monitoring : Alert Investigation Project (8 months)
Review Customer Profile Check unusual patterns
Perform KYC refresh and adverse media checks Check sanctions/adverse media Identify suspicious patterns Analyse transaction history to identify false positives Build an Investigation Narrative Escalate via SAR/STR, if not cleared or needs compliance review
Managed Client onboarding and Account Opening (Cash Ops) process for Singapore and Hong Kong regions for 2 yrs, with limited staN and received huge appreciation from top management for achieving timely delivery and desired quality.
Reduced turnaround time involved for opening trade Account from 38 minutes to 15 minutes
(60%) through automation (macros).
Fidelity Investments Associate (Research Analyst) :
Jul 2005 - Mar 2007
Worked as Research and Resolution Analyst for a leading US HealthCare provider:
Resolving participants' queries regarding claims Preparation of Insurance policies and Certificates
Enrolling/disenrolling of participants/dependents into various healthcare plans based on
eligibility/non-payment of premium.
Calculating premiums and intimating partiton due,if any. Finding out if the Participant has been terminated correctly for the non- payment of premium. Reconciling the accounts of the Retired persons on timely basis and adjusting the balance. To see if the pension deductions have been made properly against premium due. Quality checks and feedback discussion for aligned members
